# Independent manual workflows

**Bump version** validates the selected immutable source and remote branch,
then pushes one source-only direct-child commit. Its only input is the required
`patch` (default), `minor`, or `major` choice. It never builds, tags, releases,
or dispatches another workflow.

**Build** uses only the built-in ref selector, with no custom inputs. It builds
the selected `github.sha`, derives the canonical `X.Y.Z` from source, and refuses
an occupied version rather than updating an existing tag or release.
Neither workflow responds to tag pushes. No default-branch-only restriction
is imposed.

## Source authority

The canonical API identity is `miyako/4d-plugin-com4d-v3`, default branch
`master`. API default, symbolic `origin/HEAD`, advertised HEAD and intake
`d633c66ca7d4dca1ba7a158b924a21959e215efd` agreed.
The rename-follow Bump history leads to
`04d64b29e89e971d73d0f5f81f76f8a6a8053690`: its explicit header coordinates
`MARKETING_VERSION`, `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION`, and plist version fields,
although its buggy body updated marketing only.

The migration preserves authoritative **1.0.7**, without an intake increment.
Only six stale source build-version tokens and the copied source
`English.lproj/InfoPlist.strings` short/get-info display tokens are aligned from
1.0.3. Actual target/project Development, Deployment and Default configurations
are validated by identity and name. The required plist short version remains a
`$(MARKETING_VERSION)` reference; the absent optional build key remains absent.
The prebuilt destination localization and other prebuilt bundle bytes are not
source authority and are untouched by this migration.

The source helper validates every field before any write, rejecting lexical
duplicates, configuration drift, invalid versions and unresolved/cyclic
references. Only original token spans change: encoding/BOM, individual newline
styles (including the CR-only source localization), modes and unrelated bytes
are preserved.

## Native policy and retained outputs

The original Windows **Release x64** MSBuild CMD invocation, v143/SDK 10.0
overrides and artifact remain. The exact case-insensitive vcxproj output is
`test/Plugins/COM4D.bundle/Contents/Windows64/COM4D.4DX`; there is no recursive
first-match search. Cleanup removes only its proven output family and
`Objs/Release`.

macOS remains **Default**, universal arm64+x86_64, deployment override **11.0**,
with Cocoa.framework and the original explicit `CONFIGURATION_BUILD_DIR`
override. The actual bundle is `test/Plugins/COM4D.bundle`, not a new `Default`
sibling. There are no dependency builds or gitlinks. The existing project
Deployment-only signing script is unchanged; the workflow still uses Default.
No runtime dylib or i386 policy is invented.

Source localization is copied as a resource. The project's copy phase puts
`manifest.json` and `constants.xlf` directly under **Contents**, not Resources;
the stale prebuilt `Contents/Resources/constants.xlf` remains protected.
Windows32, QuickLook, prebuilt resource siblings and other nongenerated bytes
stay immutable. Cleanup prevalidates symlink/reparse safety before any deletion
and never removes whole bundles, lowercase plugin directories or Default
siblings.

Initial preflight requires a globally clean checkout, including ignored files.
Final validation instead retains fresh tracked generated bytes. Only exact
native leaves, downloaded Windows artifact, COM4D intermediates and narrow
`build/XCBuildData` database/WAL/SHM or lowercase-32-hex `.xcbuilddata`
descendants are exempted. There is no blanket bundle/build/XCBuildData exception.
Every required packaged generated leaf, including executable and signature,
must be a nonempty regular nonsymlink file at final publication. Unsigned
pre-sign validation is separate. Built XML/binary plist/localization, copied
source resources and downloaded/merged Windows bytes are revalidated.

HEAD and index must match immutable selected source, with no hidden index/stat
flags. Nongenerated raw bytes are independently hashed, not trusted to Git's
filters or stat cache. On Windows only, POSIX executable-bit differences on
regular worktree files are tolerated; raw hashes and index modes remain exact,
and reparse points/nonregular types are rejected. Process-scoped
`core.autocrlf=false` is inherited before every Build checkout, without changing
global Git configuration. Outputs are never reset to fake a clean checkout.

Notarization requires both exit zero and strict JSON `Accepted`, followed by
successful stapling and strict signature verification.

## Create-only publication and recovery

Constant `release-publication` concurrency spans refs with cancellation disabled;
it does not promise FIFO ordering. Explicit nonempty `GH_TOKEN`, exact
case-sensitive repository identity and selected `GITHUB_SHA` are required.

Availability is authenticated before native work and after all native gates.
Draft-inclusive release pages are read until an empty page, and both exact API
refs and remote advertisements must show the tag absent. Transport/auth/404,
later-page, duplicate/nonfinite JSON and schema failures stop publication.

Separate create-only requests create the tag at selected SHA, verify it through
API and Git, create a new public release with a new positive ID, then upload
only the exact versioned ZIP/DMG to that new ID. The original empty release body
and disabled generated notes are preserved. No update, reuse, clobber, deletion,
rollback, retry or combined release-and-assets command is used.

**On failure**, inspect the retained tag, release ID and assets identified in the
error. A request may have succeeded despite a lost response. Reconcile partial
state manually before choosing a new source version; do not rerun blindly.

The executable bump guard must match its committed `100755` raw blob before
edits and every final guard check, including after the second remote read.
It accepts exactly one advertised old/new branch record with a source-only
direct child, explicit Actions bot author/committer and literal ending Copilot
App co-author trailer. Advance, rewind, delete and same-result races fail closed.
Both `push.followTags=false` and `--no-follow-tags` suppress incidental tags.

## Offline validation

Python 3, PyYAML, Git, Bash and actionlint are used:

```sh
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml
```

`PLUGIN_TEST_SCRATCH` may point to an existing artifact directory. Disposable
fixtures are removed. Tests use actual Python/Bash helpers, real local Git/bare
repositories, fake gh and closed-PATH native/credential doubles. They never
invoke real native/signing/notary/4D tools or read secrets. These checks verify
offline contracts, not success of hosted native toolchains or external services.
`tests/reference-pins.json` records immutable raw-blob-verified prior art.
